facts.fact: 听筒里传来撞击声，手机从琼的指间掉落，玻璃与金属磕在地面上。
facts.anchor: a crash. The telltale clatter of the phone falling through her fingers

facts.fact: 有人低声说了一句「Sweet dreams」，随后手机被拿起、通话突然中断。
EON 那辆厢式车里押送着一个人，琼在远处把那人错认成了西德妮。
facts.anchor: EON had been transporting someone in that van. Someone June had mistaken for Sydney from a distance.

facts.fact: 维克多听出那个声音像西德妮，但更软、更甜、更成熟。
facts.anchor: like Syd’s, but softer, sweeter, more grown-up

facts.fact: 那个声音的主人的喉咙是维克多割的，那晚他堵上了耳朵。
facts.anchor: the night he cut its owner’s throat

facts.fact: 骨头不会在普通的火里化掉，夜里临时浇汽油点起来的火更不行。
facts.anchor: Bones didn’t disintegrate in ordinary fires. Certainly not in hasty ones lit with gasoline in the middle of the night.

facts.fact: 维克多想，第二次杀塞雷娜·克拉克或许会容易一些。
facts.anchor: With any luck, Serena Clarke would be easier to kill a second time.

facts.fact: 维克多听完只对米奇说了一句「开快点」。
